visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with a navy blue cap and a black baseball jersey with orange trim is seen in a close-up, looking toward the right with a neutral expression. Behind him, the blurred interior of a large stadium is visible. (2) The scene cuts to a wide, high-angle view of the interior of a massive domed stadium. A green baseball field with red dirt paths is centered, surrounded by thousands of spectators in multi-tiered seating. (3) The man is seen from behind, walking toward the Kyocera Dome Osaka entrance in daylight. He is wearing a blue shoulder bag and raises his right fist in a gesture of excitement. (4) A close-up shows two physical paper tickets held in a hand, featuring Japanese text and QR codes. (5) A first-person view shows the stadium from the upper outfield seats, providing a sweeping view of the field and the brightly lit stadium ceiling. (6) A hand holds a clear plastic cup filled with beer, featuring the 'KYOCERA DOME OSAKA' logo. The man then takes a long sip of the beer, closing his eyes. (7) The camera pans across the crowded stands where fans are waving orange towels. A massive digital screen displays game statistics and a close-up of a baseball player. (8) A bright orange menu board at a concession stand is shown, listing various food items like burgers and curry with prices in Yen. (9) Action on the field is shown: a pitcher throws, and the batter hits the ball. The crowd in the foreground waves flags and cheers. (10) The large stadium screen shows a live interview with a player and a mascot. (11) A digital screen displays a 7-Eleven ticket receipt with details about the game and the 1500 Yen price. (12) The man is shown eating fried chicken pieces with chopsticks from a paper cup and then taking a bite of takoyaki from a small box. (13) The video concludes with a final wide shot of the stadium under bright artificial lights.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 一張不到臺幣400的棒球外野票. (2) [Subtitle]: 真的就可以看得很舒服~ [Variety]: 😍😍😍. (3) [Logo]: KYOCERA DOME OSAKA. (4) [Subtitle]: 推薦大家有來大阪京瓷巨蛋看球的話. (5) [Subtitle]: 可以買上段外野自由席. (6) [Subtitle]: 票價便宜視野非常很好 因為是自由席建議早點來卡位. (7) [Subtitle]: 夏天我還是最愛在巨蛋看球 雖然不得不說跟大巨蛋一樣最上層會比較熱 不會汗流浹背. (8) [Subtitle]: 京瓷巨蛋現在是歐力士主場 但剛好這次買到巨人 難得來當主場 看兩支東京球隊在大阪廝殺. (9) [Subtitle]: 去年去東蛋看球時 剛好有拿到巨人球衣的贈品 這次就可以直接穿上 還特地從台灣帶來要比預計天穿. (10) [Subtitle]: 雖然是坐外野 但販賣部還是應有盡有 建議買現做的比較好吃等待是值得的!. (11) [Subtitle]: 這點跟台灣很不一樣 京瓷巨蛋的大螢幕也超級大 視覺效果滿分💯. (12) [Subtitle]: 外野自由席不會有主客應援的問題 像我這一區穿巨人 養樂多球衣的都有 很適合我這種 沒有特定支持隊伍的球迷. (13) [Subtitle]: 票的部分因為我是在日本7-11先買 1500日元還會額外加手續費. (14) [Subtitle]: 算下來一張是臺幣360非常俗🤩. (15) [Subtitle]: 京瓷巨蛋離大阪市區 像難波、心齋橋都不遠 逛街逛累了的話 可以排一天來看棒球哦👀.
